# Alerts

> [!NOTE]
> A note that is long enough to be wrapped, and every wrapped line has to keep the colored quote marker.

> [!TIP]
> A tip.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Something important.

> [!WARNING]
> A warning.

> [!CAUTION]
> A caution.

## Variants

> [!note]
> A lower-case marker.

> [!TIP]

> [!WARNING]
> The first paragraph.
>
> The second paragraph, followed by a nested quote:
>
> > A nested quote.

- A list item with an alert:
  > [!IMPORTANT]
  > Inside a list item.

## Regular quotes

> [!NOTE] Text after the marker on the same line.

> [!FOO]
> An unknown marker.
